components.name: Primary action
components.description: Browser documentation equivalent of FlowButtonStyle(primary: true); native SwiftUI is authoritative. CSS pixels illustrate native point sizes.

components.name: Secondary action

components.name: Visible tab navigation
components.description: Documentation layout of five native tabs. SwiftUI supplies SF Symbols, selected traits and Command-number shortcuts by visible position.
components.css: .ds-tabs{display:flex;border-bottom:1px solid rgb(0 0 0 / .08);background:rgb(96% 95% 92%)}.ds-tabs button{flex:1;border:0;border-bottom:2px solid transparent;padding:13px 10px;background:transparent;color:rgb(37% 37% 36%);font:500 11px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,sans-serif;cursor:pointer}.ds-tabs button[aria-current]{border-bottom-color:rgb(71% 23% 7%);color:rgb(12% 13% 14%);font-weight:600}.ds-tabs button:hover{background:rgb(0 0 0 / .035)}.ds-tabs button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid rgb(71% 23% 7%);outline-offset:-2px}

components.name: Session duration
components.description: 25, 50 and 90 minute native choices. Selected choice receives a flat fill; choices disable during an active session.

components.name: Elapsed-time ruler
components.description: Thirty native rectangles communicate elapsed proportion. This documentation example illustrates 40% elapsed; it does not run a timer.

components.name: Later note
components.description: Documentation equivalent of the native TextEditor surface; the application supplies autosave, count and storage-error feedback.
components.html: <textarea class="ds-note" aria-label="Note for later" placeholder="After this session…"></textarea>

narrative.overview:
Broschy translates Ulm-era functional graphics into a native macOS utility: a calm opaque surface, strongly differentiated typography, precise dividers and orange actions. The panel keeps five existing tasks close at hand without becoming a full application window. Its English labels, native controls and camera-aware layout remain part of the product.

This system replaces the former translucent Liquid Glass treatment. Light and Dark appearances use the same layout and hierarchy; only the palette changes. Warm ivory and graphite provide stable contrast regardless of the desktop behind the panel.
keyCharacteristics: Opaque, adaptive ivory and graphite surfaces.
Orange actions and selection, with separate green success and red failure states.
Left-aligned task content and a large tabular timer.
A 30-segment elapsed-time ruler and baseline tab navigation.
Native macOS interaction, accessibility and camera geometry.

rules.name: The Action Rule
rules.body: `action` and `on-action` form the primary button pair in both themes. `primary-light` and `primary-dark` are adaptive accents for progress, selected tabs, pins and activity; they are not interchangeable with the action fill.

dos: **Do** use the shared adaptive `Ink` tokens and opaque panel material.
**Do** preserve the measured camera gap, stable top edge and native focus behavior.
**Do** keep status labels, symbols, help text and keyboard access alongside color.
**Do** show actual native views in portfolio captures and label sample data honestly.
donts: **Don't** restore decorative glass, stacked translucent cards or wallpaper-dependent contrast.
**Don't** map tab shortcuts to persistent IDs; map them to visible positions.
**Don't** treat a ready agent response as successful task completion.
**Don't** claim a screenshot verifies live integrations, physical-notch placement or multi-display behavior.
